introduction: Rhode Island CCAP helps eligible families pay for care through approved child care providers.
description: Rhode Island CCAP helps eligible families pay for care through approved child care providers.

sections.who: Eligible routes include work, approved training or education, RI Works and specified teen programs. At application, the current income limit is 261% of federal poverty; age and residence rules also apply.
sections.get: The program covers all or part of approved care costs. A household copayment and authorized hours may apply.
sections.docs:
• Household income and address evidence.
  • Child age and relationship information.
  • Work, school or training schedule and requested provider details.
sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use HealthyRhode, a paper application or DHS phone intake at 855-697-4347.

  2. Submit the checklist

    Provide the requested verification of your eligibility route.

  3. Select approved care

    Confirm the provider’s participation, authorization and family share before relying on payment.
sections.after: Follow CCAP’s own change-reporting rules, which differ from other benefits. Report address and household changes as instructed.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using CCAP eligibility and intake. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Specified Rhode Island public college degree programs are eligible routes.
